notes.title: Gamepad Support and Advanced Settings Update
notes.content:
This update focuses on enhancing your gaming experience with controller and keyboards, inspired by your invaluable feedback—yes, we're listening! We hope you enjoy the new features and stay healthy as seasons change.

Full Gamepad Support Now Available!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723805/51d6e3cf60e9ccbbbfbaa1e6e6d4743ec8a8c8d8.png
Our games now support gamepads! You can play through the entire game using either a controller or a keyboard. We’ve updated the UI to support Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo Switch controllers seamlessly. The icons will automatically detect and update when using the controller, but you can manually switch icons via [Advanced Settings] → [Controller].
Note: We've removed the previous Steam controller configurations to prevent conflicts as the game now has full gamepad support.

Cat Mode Unleashed
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723805/08d7e0b064d538cabf057e92e78902b53568f618.gif
We've received loads of feedback about the stress of step counting. 
Introducing Cat Mode! All performance statuses will be replaced with adorable cats—no more worrying about your steps! Enjoying fun for pure puzzle-solving.
(Note: You'll still need to meet badge requirements to unlock the last two endings.)

Display Metrics and Step Counts:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723805/e56a7f8498c30d3344f70f651a0d6f2b319639c4.png
Turn on this option to display steps/metrics in the designated area at the bottom right corner—perfect for those who love pushing the limits of each level.

Toggle Sound Effects and Volume Icons:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44723805/dde95b6f8fd3fb35e66f31bfe0d0a74f0ba33487.png
We've had mixed feedback on the icons for sound effects and music being swapped, so now you can decide for yourself which is which! (Sadly, we missed the chance to release this on April Fool's, but maybe we’ll revisit it next year!)

More Advanced Settings:

 Q and F can now act as redo/undo: No more awkward hand movements with Z and Y!
 Hide Background: Turn off floating characters, ideal for video creators or those who dislike distractions.
 Skip Episode : Dive straight into level.
 Input Repeat Delay: Adjust the control sensitivity to your liking.
 Switch X/Y, A/B buttons on controllers: Catering to different user preferences.

Lastly, if you encounter any issues, feel free to report your bugs [here], and we’ll look into them earnestly. We’ll keep an older version of the game available for a while, so if you want to play it, you can find it by right-clicking the game → [Properties] → [Betas].

PS: Regarding the issue of "achievements not showing on profile pages", Gabe said it's because we need more sales…

notes.title: Send the Bugs to Valhalla too!
notes.content:
Game bugs are like LEG0 blocks on the floor: you never know where they come from, and you can't predict how much pain they might cause. Fortunately, we now have a dedicated place to report these bugs. You can share any bugs you encounter in this post.

Feel free to report bugs in any format, without pressure or stress!
However, a more detailed and comprehensive description of the bug you encounter will help us understand and fix it more quickly!

A detailed description includes:
How to Reproduce:
(Describe the steps to reproduce the bug)

Expected Results:
(Describe what should happen if everything works properly)

Actual Results:
(Describe what actually happens, which is likely where the bug occurs)

Images or Videos:
(Feedback with images or videos tends to be more intuitive! You can submit them through uploads or external links)

For users with QQ, you can also join our QQ group and submit your bug images and videos there. Our programmers usually pay attention to the group chat.
Our QQ group is: 814519506
